_note: Agent eval cases. Each case runs on a freshly seeded database against the live model. `expect` on a step lists the pass criteria for that step; `checks` are verified against the database after the last step. A case passes only if every criterion passes. Expected results are derived from the PRD (§7, §8, §10.2), not from observed behaviour.

gates._note: Minimum share of trials that must pass, per category. Security and deterministic code paths must be perfect; categories that depend on the classifier's reading of natural language get a small allowance.

classifier.description: How a message becomes an intent, entities and sentiment (LLM classifier, prompt, contract).

cascade.description: The local-model-first classifier and its routing. Run with CLASSIFIER_PROVIDER=cascade (the runner switches to it for you).

injection.description: Prompt-injection defences: classifier flag, deterministic guard, message boundary, preprocessing.

policy.description: Deterministic rules: return window, final sale, exchange limits, stock, order status.

writes.description: Confirmation cards, idempotent writes and retries against the company's system.

responder.description: Model-written replies and the deterministic output check.

handoff.description: When and how a conversation goes to a person.
